REMOTE OPERATOR COMMAND
========================

This file is the persistent command input for the prepared GitHub Actions Remote Operator.

The command written here is intended to be read by the Remote Operator workflow and executed on the configured remote server over SSH.

IMPORTANT:
- Never store secrets, private keys, access tokens, passwords, or other credentials in this file.
- Keep commands reproducible and explicit.
- Each technical operator request should update this file and create a technical commit so GitHub Actions can detect the change.
- The workflow must record execution status, exit code, stdout, stderr, and timestamps in its result artifacts.

CURRENT COMMAND:

# Write the shell command to execute below this marker.
# Example:
# docker compose ps
